bs-pref-fileextensions-help: Noocyada faylasha lagu soo gelin karo wiki-ga. Noocyo qaar (tusaale, html, js, php, cgi, exe) looma oggola sababo amni awgood xitaa haddii halkan lagu daray
bs-pref-imageextensions-help: Noocyada faylasha sawirrada ee lagu soo gelin karo wiki-ga. Qaababka suurtagalka ah ee webka: gif, png, jpg, jpeg. Qaababka kale ee sawirrada: tiff, bmp
bs-pref-logopath-help: Astaanta waa in lagu kaydiyaa galka /w/images ee rakibiddaada. Haddii aad ku kaydiso galka /w/skins ee rakibiddaada BlueSpice, waxaa lagu dul qori karaa marka la cusboonaysiiyo
bs-pref-faviconpath-help: Favicon-ka waa in lagu kaydiyaa galka /w/images ee rakibiddaada. Haddii aad ku kaydiso galka /w/skins ee rakibiddaada BlueSpice, waxaa lagu dul-qori karaa marka la cusboonaysiiyo. Favicons-ku waxay leeyihiin kordhinta faylka .ico
